calculation_handling.description: Scope statement: Section 220.5 applies to all loading spaces and the driveways leading to them. It sets no value.
General duty to provide and maintain a loading space for each use, in compliance with Chapter 220. The numbers come from the Chapter 220 regulations, not from this clause.

220.5.1(1).explanation: The loading space rules in Section 220.5 apply to every loading space and to the driveways that lead to one.

220.5.1(2).explanation: Each use on a lot must have a loading space provided and kept up, following the Chapter 220 rules.
